sections.heading: Ramadan Calendar Box (Arch Design) FAQ
sections.text: Questions Ramadan Calendar Box (Arch Design) FAQ How many drawers does a Ramadan calendar box have? Most have 30, one for each day of Ramadan. The drawer count and size are confirmed after we review your structure and contents. Can the drawers hold dates or chocolates? Yes. Drawers can carry wrapped dates, chocolates or sweets; food-contact requirements are reviewed on the quote. Can the artwork include our own Ramadan design? Yes. You can use your own artwork, or hot foil line work such as crescents, stars and arch borders. When should we order for Ramadan? Start early enough to approve the structure and a physical sample before bulk production, plus freight time. We confirm the schedule on the quote.

Your box is developed to your specification and approved on a physical sample before bulk production. A Ramadan calendar box gives one small drawer to each day of the holy month. This design shapes the top of the cabinet as an arch, with a gold foil crescent and border, over 30 numbered drawers. Families, gift brands and companies fill the drawers with dates, sweets, small gifts or notes, and the box returns to the shelf each year.
